# Pusaka

> NFTs on NEAR that hold native Bitcoin. Each Pusaka (NEP-171 token) controls its own Bitcoin address through NEAR Chain Signatures; selling the NFT transfers control of the BTC in one NEAR transaction, with no bridge, wrapped BTC or custodian.

Network: NEAR testnet (contract `pusaka-btc.testnet`, MPC signer `v1.signer-prod.testnet`) Bitcoin testnet3, whose headers NEAR's Bitcoin light client `btc-client-v4.testnet` tracks, and Ethereum Sepolia (same MPC key).

## How to use this site

- `/#/` lists every Pusaka with the BTC verified on NEAR, and the total across all of them.
- `/#/pusaka/{id}` shows one Pusaka: Bitcoin address (with a BIP21 `bitcoin:` link), BTC proven by the light client, ETH inside, on-chain history, and actions (mint, list or Dutch auction, buy, borrow, lend, withdraw) after connecting a NEAR testnet wallet.

## For agents

- Remote MCP (Streamable HTTP, read-only): https://pusaka-two.vercel.app/api/mcp — tools `pusaka_overview`, `pusaka_inspect` (verified BTC, USD value, ETH safe/at-risk, listing premium, loan LTV/APR).
- Trading tools (buy, lend, prove, withdraw) run locally: `mcp/server.mjs` in the repo, with your own NEAR key and a spend cap.
- Gas-free deposit proofs: `POST /api/prove {"token_id": "1"}`.
- Gas-free owner actions (NEP-366): `POST /api/relay {"signed_delegate": "<base64 borsh SignedDelegate>"}` for list, cancel_listing, request_loan, cancel_loan_request, claim_collateral.

## Docs

- [Source code and README](https://github.com/PugarHuda/pusaka): reproducible steps, threat model mapped to tests, measured testnet results
- [Contract on NEAR testnet](https://testnet.near.rocks/account/pusaka-btc.testnet)
